reason: B is the stronger proposal because it frames thermally activated interfacial dislocation nucleation and transmission more coherently and supplies clearer low- and high-temperature boundaries that distinguish it from diffusion-dominated creep. Both interventions risk confounding interface coherency with annealing- or thickness-induced changes, but A additionally relies on questionable dislocation pileups in nanoscale layers and an insufficiently justified transition from pileup to interface sliding.
